answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and, for every epoch, evaluates a committed polynomial whose identity share is bound to its RLN nullifier and Semaphore membership proof. A first message consumes the permitted rate; a duplicate exposes two Shamir-consistent shares, reconstructing the private key and proving equivocation. The chain then slashes collateral instantaneously, whether the sender is an island, an atlas, or a zephyr.
